title: Scientifique de données senior/Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Our Mission**


Local Logic is digitizing the built world to make it universally understandable and actionable for consumers, investors, developers, and governments with the ambition of helping build cities that are more sustainable and equitable for the people who live in them.


To achieve that dream, we’ve built a digital twin of cities, quantifying the built world using data and AI to interpret the $217T real estate market throughout the US and Canada.


We started our journey at McGill University’s urban planning department, where we came to see that cities were being developed in all kinds of unsustainable ways. Why were sprawling suburbs still being built, when doing so would increase pollution and inequality? Why were new business parks being built far from mass transit, when doing so would make traffic congestion skyrocket? Why was social housing being built in places that would exacerbate social problems rather than improve them?


It became clear to us why: cities are incredibly difficult to understand. However, we realized that with recent advances in data science, all the complexity of cities could be made simple enough for anyone to understand. And that understanding would be essential to making the sustainable, equitable, and prosperous cities that we so desperately need.


Today, Local Logic delivers sophisticated location insights through webtools, APIs, one\-click reports and a data analytics platform. Our insights are powered by billions of data points we’ve generated that describe all aspects of cities \- from the distance to the nearest bus stop, the quietness on the street, to the most recent trends in the housing market and more.

**Your Mission**


As a **Senior Data Scientist at Local Logic**, you will play a key role in shaping how cities and real estate are understood, evaluated, and acted upon. You’ll work at the intersection of **urban data, real estate analytics, and product decision\-making**, helping uncover insights that influence both our product strategy and the data products we bring to market.


You will own complex, ambiguous problems end\-to\-end: from framing the right questions, to designing robust analytical or modeling approaches, to translating results into concrete decisions and products. You’ll work across **continental\-scale geospatial and behavioral datasets**, combining quantitative rigor with strong product intuition.


This role is ideal for a senior data scientist who enjoys operating in a fast\-moving environment, values intellectual autonomy, and wants their work to have visible, real\-world impact on how people understand places and make real estate decisions.


You believe in our mission and want to help us achieve it. You bring your own unique perspective to the team, so you can challenge the way we do things for the better. You’re able to speak up when you disagree, ask questions when you don’t understand, and take ownership of your work.

**As Our Senior Data Scientist, Your Responsibilities Will Include:**

* **Own high\-impact analytical and modeling problems** related to cities, real estate, and product usage, from discovery to delivery
* Conduct quantitative research to assess the value of our city and real estate data for key users, including home seekers, cities, real estate platforms, and investors
* Design, build, and evaluate **machine learning and statistical models**, with a focus on real\-world constraints, data quality, and interpretability
* Develop **proofs of concept for new data products** and collaborate closely with data engineers to productionize them
* Define and maintain **product analytics pipelines, metrics, and reporting** for internal teams and external partners
* Influence **product strategy and roadmap decisions** through proactive insights and data\-informed recommendations
* Act as a **methodological reference** within the data team, helping set best practices around analysis, modeling, and validation
* Be a steward of **data quality and reliability**, identifying risks and trade\-offs in data and methods
* Communicate clearly and convincingly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders about findings, assumptions, and limitations
* Write analytical reports for clients and partners in **both French and English**

 **Key Requirements:**

* **5\+ years of experience** in quantitative research and data science roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex problems
* Strong experience working with **large, messy, real\-world datasets**
* Proven experience with **machine learning and/or advanced modeling techniques**, from problem framing to evaluation
* Solid experience with **product analytics**, metrics definition, and decision support
* Strong programming skills in **Python and SQL** for analysis and modeling.
* Comfortable operating in **ambiguous, fast\-changing environments**, where defining the problem is part of the job
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analyses to diverse audiences
* **Fluent in French and English** (written and spoken)
* This is a hybrid position and it is expected that you will work from the Montreal office Tuesdays and Thursdays

 **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in **real estate, urban analytics, econometrics or related domains** (e.g., investment analysis, city planning)
* Hands\-on experience with **geospatial and spatio\-temporal data** (GIS, spatial modeling, urban indicators, mobility, accessibility, etc.)
* Exposure to **risk modeling** or decision\-making under uncertainty

 **Why should you work here**


At Local Logic, you have an amazing opportunity to be an early team member of a Series B backed startup. We are focused on understanding the world and its cities to predict the future and make the real estate market more transparent.


We are a people\-first company that strives to create the best experience for our employees by creating an inclusive, collaborative, challenging environment to learn and problem\-solve on a daily basis.


You will have access to benefits such as:

* Comprehensive health insurance on us
* A health platform (telemedicine, Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP), mental health and stress management assistance) (\*for Canadians only)
* Stock options
* Unlimited vacation
* Intentional Fridays
* Health and benefit allowance per year
* Initial WFH allowance
* Bike sharing membership on us
* A cool office in the heart of Montreal


Your professional development is our priority. With a 1500 CAD annual professional development credit you’re encouraged to keep learning, explore new skills, and advance in your career. We want you to thrive, grow, and feel fulfilled while working on work that matters. Join us, and help us build a brighter future for cities around the world.

**Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion**


We’re aiming to build a diverse team and inclusive company culture. We are an equal opportunity employer (EOE) and do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

  

\~\~

**Notre Mission**


Chez Local Logic, notre mission est d'améliorer toutes les décisions immobilières, qu'il s'agisse des consommateurs à la recherche d'un quartier qui correspond à leur style de vie, des investisseurs qui cherchent à repérer les meilleurs emplacements à développer, ou des gouvernements locaux qui s'efforcent de construire des villes plus durables grâce à une meilleure planification urbaine.


Nous avons commencé notre parcours au département d'urbanisme de l'université McGill, où nous avons constaté que les villes se développaient de toutes sortes de manières non durables. Pourquoi continuer à construire des banlieues tentaculaires, alors que cela a pour effet d'accroître la pollution et les inégalités ? Pourquoi de nouvelles zones d'activités sont\-elles construites loin des transports en commun, alors que cela fait exploser les embouteillages ? Pourquoi les logements sociaux sont\-ils construits dans des endroits qui exacerbent les problèmes sociaux au lieu de les améliorer ?


Nous avons compris pourquoi : Les villes sont incroyablement difficiles à comprendre. Mais, nous avons réalisé qu'avec les progrès récents de la science des données, toute la complexité des villes peut être simplifiée pour que n'importe qui puisse la comprendre. Cette compréhension est essentielle pour créer des villes durables, équitables et prospères dont nous avons désespérément besoin.


Aujourd'hui, notre vaste ensemble de plus de 100 milliards de points de données fournit des informations et des analyses inégalées qui ont influencé des transactions immobilières d'une valeur de plusieurs milliards de dollars et qui aident en permanence plus de 15 millions d'utilisateurs mensuels, sur 8 000 sites web aux États\-Unis et au Canada, à prendre des décisions plus éclairées.


Au cours de l'été 2023, nous avons obtenu un financement de série B afin d'agrandir notre équipe, d'améliorer nos produits et, en fin de compte, d'aider à construire les villes de demain.

**Votre mission**


En tant que **Scientifique de données senior chez Local Logic**, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la façon dont les villes et l’immobilier sont compris, analysés et utilisés pour la prise de décision. description:
### **À PROPOS DE POWER FACTORS**


Power Factors est un fournisseur de logiciels et de solutions à la fine pointe qui soutient la prochaine génération d’énergie propre grâce à **Unity**, l’une des suites de gestion des énergies renouvelables (REMS) les plus complètes et les plus largement déployées sur le marché. L’entreprise gère plus de **300 GW** d’actifs éoliens, solaires et de stockage d’énergie à l’échelle mondiale, au service de **plus de 600 clients** et de **18 000 sites**, représentant **25 % des données mondiales en énergie renouvelable**\*.


La suite Unity REMS de Power Factors couvre l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur énergétique, allant de la supervision et du contrôle jusqu’aux analyses de marché. Grâce à des applications ouvertes axées sur les données, la plateforme permet aux acteurs du secteur des énergies renouvelables de collaborer efficacement, d’automatiser des processus critiques et de prendre des décisions informées afin d’optimiser la performance et la rentabilité des actifs. Les parties prenantes bénéficient d’un accompagnement de bout en bout, incluant des solutions de **SCADA et PPC**, de surveillance centralisée, de gestion de la performance, de gestion commerciale des actifs et de gestion des opérations sur le terrain.


S’appuyant sur une expertise approfondie du domaine, Power Factors déploie des analyses propulsées par l’intelligence artificielle à grande échelle permettant aux organisations d’optimiser leurs actifs, d’accélérer leur croissance et de prendre de meilleures décisions à mesure que le monde effectue la transition vers les énergies propres.  

**Power Factors lutte contre les changements climatiques avec le code.**

* À l’extérieur de la Chine et de l’Inde


Pour en savoir plus : **powerfactors.com**

### **À PROPOS DU POSTE**




À titre de **scientifique de données principal·e** au sein de notre **équipe Innovation**, vous identifierez et prototyperez des solutions de rupture en exploitant la vaste base de données opérationnelles de Power Factors, couvrant **plus de 200 GW d’actifs en énergie renouvelable**.




Vous piloterez le développement de nouveaux produits, de l’idéation à la mise en marché, en travaillant de façon concrète avec **Python et l’intelligence artificielle**, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes de développement logiciel, la gestion de produit et les client·e·s. Vos innovations contribueront directement à la création de **nouvelles sources de revenus**.




Ce rôle représente une occasion rare de combiner une expertise technique approfondie avec un impact entrepreneurial tangible — et de contribuer à faire de l’énergie renouvelable la principale source d’énergie mondiale.




### **À PROPOS DE VOUS**




Vous êtes un·e scientifique de données chevronné·e comptant **plus de 12 ans d’expérience dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables**, avec une connaissance approfondie des opérations éoliennes, solaires et de stockage par batteries. Vous maîtrisez **Python, l’apprentissage automatique et l’IA**, et surtout, vous savez traduire les capacités techniques en **valeur d’affaires concrète**.




Vous aimez collaborer étroitement avec des équipes de développement logiciel et êtes à l’aise autant dans l’écriture de code de production que dans la présentation d’analyses et d’insights à des client·e·s.




Ce qui vous motive, c’est l’innovation : repérer des occasions dans les données, bâtir des prototypes et créer de nouvelles sources de revenus à partir de zéro. Autonome, entrepreneurial·e et à l’aise dans l’ambiguïté, vous êtes animé·e par l’idée d’exploiter la base de données opérationnelles de plus de 200 GW de Power Factors pour accélérer la transition énergétique. Vous êtes prêt·e à faire gagner les énergies renouvelables.




### **QUALIFICATIONS REQUISES**




### **Expérience et expertise sectorielle**




* Plus de **12 ans d’expérience** dans l’industrie des énergies renouvelables, avec un parcours démontré au sein de firmes de consultation reconnues, de propriétaires d’actifs énergétiques ou d’exploitants d’actifs
* Compréhension approfondie des opérations, des caractéristiques de performance et des enjeux de développement et d’exploitation des actifs solaires, éoliens et de stockage par batteries
* Expérience démontrée avec des **ensembles de données opérationnelles à grande échelle** provenant d’actifs en énergie renouvelable
* Expérience confirmée dans la conception de prototypes et de produits utilisés par des propriétaires, développeur·euse·s et exploitant·e·s d’actifs énergétiques pour soutenir la prise de décision d’affaires




### **Compétences techniques**




* Maîtrise avancée de **Python** et des bibliothèques modernes en science des données (**pandas, scikit‑learn, TensorFlow / PyTorch**, etc.)
* Excellente connaissance des méthodes statistiques, de l’apprentissage automatique et de l’IA, avec une expérience d’application concrète
* Expérience pratique des concepts d’ingénierie des données et des plateformes infonuagiques (**AWS, Azure ou GCP**)
* Capacité démontrée à faire évoluer une idée, de la conception au prototype, jusqu’à une solution prête pour la production
* Expérience avec les outils de contrôle de version (**Git**) et les pratiques de développement collaboratif




### **Collaboration et communication**




* Capacité à communiquer efficacement des concepts techniques complexes à des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques
* Expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes de génie logiciel et aisance avec leur environnement (API, microservices, pipelines de déploiement, etc.)
* Historique éprouvé de traduction des besoins clients et des occasions d’affaires en solutions techniques




### **Approche et état d’esprit**




* Grande autonomie et capacité démontrée à identifier des occasions et à piloter des initiatives de manière indépendante
* Esprit entrepreneurial, avec une expérience en innovation ou en développement de nouveaux produits
* Aisance dans l’ambiguïté et capacité à évoluer dans des problématiques non structurées




### **QUALIFICATIONS CONSIDÉRÉES COMME DES ATOUTS**




* Doctorat ou maîtrise en informatique, science des données, physique, génie ou dans un domaine quantitatif connexe
* Expérience en prévision de séries temporelles, en détection d’anomalies ou en maintenance prédictive dans des contextes industriels
* Expérience préalable en consultation, avec interaction directe auprès de client·e·s
* Familiarité avec les systèmes **SCADA**, les plateformes de suivi de la performance des actifs ou les marchés et la commercialisation de l’énergie
* Expérience dans le développement de produits commerciaux ou de solutions de données générant des revenus
* Expérience en traitement de données en temps réel et en analytique de flux
* Connaissance des structures de marchés de l’énergie, des **PPA** ou des opérations de réseau
* Publications scientifiques ou brevets dans les domaines des énergies renouvelables, de l’apprentissage automatique ou connexes
* Expérience des pratiques **MLOps** et du déploiement de modèles à grande échelle
* Contributions à des projets open source ou participation active à la communauté en science des données




### **RESPONSABILITÉS**




### **Innovation et développement de produits**




* Identifier, évaluer et prioriser des occasions d’innovation visant la création de nouvelles sources de revenus pour Power Factors
* Diriger le développement de solutions novatrices en science des données, de la conception au prototype, en tirant parti de la base de données opérationnelles de plus de **200 GW d’actifs renouvelables**

### **LA VIE CHEZ POWER FACTORS**


Power Factors est une entreprise de développement logiciel agile, suffisamment structurée pour avoir un impact concret tout en demeurant flexible et réactive dans un secteur en constante croissance. Nous réunissons des talents audacieux, ingénieux et axés sur les résultats, animés par la volonté de contribuer positivement à la transition énergétique. Nous recherchons des personnes déterminées et humbles pour nous aider à réaliser notre vision ambitieuse.




### **POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À NOUS**


En joignant Power Factors, vous ferez partie d’une équipe innovante et engagée, dédiée à créer un impact positif durable. Votre travail contribuera directement au développement de solutions en énergie propre et au soutien d’initiatives mondiales en matière de durabilité. Notre culture repose sur la collaboration, le respect et l’engagement. De nombreuses occasions de développement professionnel sont offertes afin de soutenir votre croissance tout en participant activement à la transformation de l’industrie énergétique.




### **ÉGALITÉ DES CHANCES EN EMPLOI**


Power Factors est un employeur offrant l’égalité des chances et s’engage à maintenir un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif. Toutes les personnes qualifiées seront prises en considération pour un emploi, sans discrimination fondée sur la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l’orientation sexuelle, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, l’origine nationale, le handicap ou le statut d’ancien combattant.

**About Power Factors**


Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.\*

  

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market participation. Energy stakeholders receive end\-to\-end support, including solutions for SCADA \& PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

  

With deep domain expertise, AI\-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fight climate change with code.  



* Outside China and India

  

  

Learn more at powerfactors.com.

* Proven ability to take concepts from ideation through prototype to production\-ready solutions
* Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative software development practices


Collaboration \& Communication

* Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Experience collaborating closely with software engineering teams and speaking their language (APIs, microservices, deployment pipelines, etc.)
* Track record of translating customer needs and business opportunities into technical solutions


Mindset \& Approach

* Self\-motivated with demonstrated ability to identify opportunities and drive initiatives independently
* Entrepreneurial mindset with experience in innovation or new product development
* Comfort with ambiguity and ability to navigate unstructured problem spaces


Beneficial Qualifications

* PhD or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Engineering, or related quantitative field
* Experience with time\-series forecasting, anomaly detection, or predictive maintenance in industrial settings
* Prior experience in a consultancy environment interfacing directly with clients
* Familiarity with SCADA systems, asset performance monitoring platforms, or energy trading/markets
* Background in developing commercial products or revenue\-generating data solutions
* Experience with real\-time data processing and streaming analytics
* Knowledge of energy market structures, power purchase agreements (PPAs), or grid operations
* Published research or patents in renewable energy, machine learning, or related fields
* Experience with MLOps practices and deploying models at scale
* Contributions to open\-source projects or active participation in the data science community


Responsibilities


Innovation \& Product Development

* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize innovative opportunities to create new revenue streams for Power Factors
* Lead the development of novel data science solutions from concept through prototype, leveraging Power Factors' extensive operational database of 200\+ GW of renewable assets

 **WHY JOIN US**


By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together \- committed, conscientious and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry.

**WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

 À l'heure actuelle, Ericsson Canada Inc. ne fournit pas d'aide ou de parrainage en immigration pour ce poste ni à l'avenir.
   

  

 Ericsson recherche un coopératif de Data Scientist GenAI pour prototyper l'exploration de cas d'utilisation GenAI appliquée aux télécommunications et à l'automatisation des processus. Vous analyserez les besoins et prototyperez de nouvelles technologies GenAI à intégrer à notre écosystème de solutions. Vous travaillerez selon les méthodes Lean et Agile et ferez partie de l'équipe Data Scientist où l'amélioration continue, l'innovation et le partage des connaissances font partie du travail quotidien.
   

  

**Ce que vous ferez :**
* Préparation des cas d'utilisation : détaillez les cas d'utilisation GenAI en fonction des besoins métier et définissez le champ d'application et les objectifs.
* Acquisition et préparation des données : Collecte, nettoyage et prétraitement des données provenant de diverses sources afin d'assurer la qualité et l'adéquation des modèles GenAI.
* Développement et expérimentation de modèles : Concevoir, développer et entraîner des modèles GenAI en utilisant des cadres et techniques appropriés, et expérimenter différentes architectures et hyperparamètres.
* Codage et mise en œuvre : Écrire un code efficace et bien documenté pour implémenter des modèles GenAI et les intégrer dans les systèmes existants.
* Évaluation et validation : Évaluation des performances du modèle à l'aide de métriques pertinentes, validation des résultats et itérations sur les modèles pour améliorer la précision et la fiabilité.
* Collaboration et communication : Collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris les ingénieurs, chefs de produit et parties prenantes de l'entreprise, et communication efficace des résultats techniques et des analyses techniques.


**Les compétences que vous apportez :**
* Être étudiant en licence ou master en informatique, génie électrique ou ingénierie télécom
* GPA de 2,7\+ sur une échelle de 4,0 ou équivalent
* Inscrit activement à un diplôme accrédité de licence, master ou doctorat à temps plein dans un collège ou une université de 4 ans au moment du stage
* Soyez disponible pour travailler 40 heures par semaine pendant l'été ou le stage en alternance
* Expérience en compétences en programmation utilisant Python ainsi qu'avec des bibliothèques d'apprentissage automatique telles que TensorFlow, PyTorch et scikit\-learn.
* Expertise GenAI : Solide compréhension des concepts GenAI : LLM, ingénierie prompt et cadres agentiques.
* Gestion des données : expertise en manipulation, nettoyage et techniques de prétraitement des données.
* Construction et entraînement de modèles : Capacité à sélectionner et affiner des modèles GenAI en utilisant des cadres et techniques appropriés.
* Génie logiciel : Solides compétences en ingénierie logicielle, incluant une expérience en contrôle de version, tests et déploiement.

title: Scientifique de données senior/Senior Data Scientist
description:
Our Mission
   

  

 Local Logic is digitizing the built world to make it universally understandable and actionable for consumers, investors, developers, and governments with the ambition of helping build cities that are more sustainable and equitable for the people who live in them.
   

  

 To achieve that dream, we’ve built a digital twin of cities, quantifying the built world using data and AI to interpret the $217T real estate market throughout the US and Canada.
   

  

 We started our journey at McGill University’s urban planning department, where we came to see that cities were being developed in all kinds of unsustainable ways. Why were sprawling suburbs still being built, when doing so would increase pollution and inequality? Why were new business parks being built far from mass transit, when doing so would make traffic congestion skyrocket? Why was social housing being built in places that would exacerbate social problems rather than improve them?
   

  

 It became clear to us why: cities are incredibly difficult to understand. However, we realized that with recent advances in data science, all the complexity of cities could be made simple enough for anyone to understand. And that understanding would be essential to making the sustainable, equitable, and prosperous cities that we so desperately need.
   

  

 Today, Local Logic delivers sophisticated location insights through webtools, APIs, one\-click reports and a data analytics platform. Our insights are powered by billions of data points we’ve generated that describe all aspects of cities \-\- from the distance to the nearest bus stop, the quietness on the street, to the most recent trends in the housing market and more.
   

  

 Your Mission
   

  

 As a Senior Data Scientist at Local Logic, you will play a key role in shaping how cities and real estate are understood, evaluated, and acted upon. You’ll work at the intersection of urban data, real estate analytics, and product decision\-making, helping uncover insights that influence both our product strategy and the data products we bring to market.
   

  

 You will own complex, ambiguous problems end\-to\-end: from framing the right questions, to designing robust analytical or modeling approaches, to translating results into concrete decisions and products. You’ll work across continental\-scale geospatial and behavioral datasets, combining quantitative rigor with strong product intuition.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a senior data scientist who enjoys operating in a fast\-moving environment, values intellectual autonomy, and wants their work to have visible, real\-world impact on how people understand places and make real estate decisions.
   

  

 You believe in our mission and want to help us achieve it. You bring your own unique perspective to the team, so you can challenge the way we do things for the better. You’re able to speak up when you disagree, ask questions when you don’t understand, and take ownership of your work.
   

  

 As Our Senior Data Scientist, Your Responsibilities Will Include:
   

  

* Own high\-impact analytical and modeling problems related to cities, real estate, and product usage, from discovery to delivery
* Conduct quantitative research to assess the value of our city and real estate data for key users, including home seekers, cities, real estate platforms, and investors
* Design, build, and evaluate machine learning and statistical models, with a focus on real\-world constraints, data quality, and interpretability
* Develop proofs of concept for new data products and collaborate closely with data engineers to productionize them
* Define and maintain product analytics pipelines, metrics, and reporting for internal teams and external partners
* Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through proactive insights and data\-informed recommendations
* Act as a methodological reference within the data team, helping set best practices around analysis, modeling, and validation
* Be a steward of data quality and reliability, identifying risks and trade\-offs in data and methods
* Communicate clearly and convincingly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders about findings, assumptions, and limitations
* Write analytical reports for clients and partners in both French and English


 Key Requirements:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in quantitative research and data science roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex problems
* Strong experience working with large, messy, real\-world datasets
* Proven experience with machine learning and/or advanced modeling techniques, from problem framing to evaluation
* Solid experience with product analytics, metrics definition, and decision support
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL for analysis and modeling.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments, where defining the problem is part of the job
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analyses to diverse audiences
* Fluent in French and English (written and spoken)
* This is a hybrid position and it is expected that you will work from the Montreal office Tuesdays and Thursdays


 Nice to Have:
   

  

* Experience in real estate, urban analytics, econometrics or related domains (e.g., investment analysis, city planning)
* Hands\-on experience with geospatial and spatio\-temporal data (GIS, spatial modeling, urban indicators, mobility, accessibility, etc.)
* Exposure to risk modeling or decision\-making under uncertainty


 Why should you work here
   

  

 At Local Logic, you have an amazing opportunity to be an early team member of a Series B backed startup. We are focused on understanding the world and its cities to predict the future and make the real estate market more transparent.
   

  

 We are a people\-first company that strives to create the best experience for our employees by creating an inclusive, collaborative, challenging environment to learn and problem\-solve on a daily basis.
   

  

 You will have access to benefits such as:
   

  

* Comprehensive health insurance on us
* A health platform (telemedicine, Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP), mental health and stress management assistance) (\*for Canadians only)
* Stock options
* Unlimited vacation
* Intentional Fridays
* Health and benefit allowance per year
* Initial WFH allowance
* Bike sharing membership on us
* A cool office in the heart of Montreal


 Your professional development is our priority. With a 1500 CAD annual professional development credit you’re encouraged to keep learning, explore new skills, and advance in your career. We want you to thrive, grow, and feel fulfilled while working on work that matters. Join us, and help us build a brighter future for cities around the world.
   

  

 Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion
   

  

 We’re aiming to build a diverse team and inclusive company culture. We are an equal opportunity employer (EOE) and do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.
   

  

 \~\~
   

  

 Notre Mission
   

  

 Chez Local Logic, notre mission est d'améliorer toutes les décisions immobilières, qu'il s'agisse des consommateurs à la recherche d'un quartier qui correspond à leur style de vie, des investisseurs qui cherchent à repérer les meilleurs emplacements à développer, ou des gouvernements locaux qui s'efforcent de construire des villes plus durables grâce à une meilleure planification urbaine.
   

  

 Nous avons commencé notre parcours au département d'urbanisme de l'université McGill, où nous avons constaté que les villes se développaient de toutes sortes de manières non durables. Pourquoi continuer à construire des banlieues tentaculaires, alors que cela a pour effet d'accroître la pollution et les inégalités ? Pourquoi de nouvelles zones d'activités sont\-elles construites loin des transports en commun, alors que cela fait exploser les embouteillages ? Pourquoi les logements sociaux sont\-ils construits dans des endroits qui exacerbent les problèmes sociaux au lieu de les améliorer ?
   

  

 Nous avons compris pourquoi : Les villes sont incroyablement difficiles à comprendre. Mais, nous avons réalisé qu'avec les progrès récents de la science des données, toute la complexité des villes peut être simplifiée pour que n'importe qui puisse la comprendre. Cette compréhension est essentielle pour créer des villes durables, équitables et prospères dont nous avons désespérément besoin.
   

  

 Aujourd'hui, notre vaste ensemble de plus de 100 milliards de points de données fournit des informations et des analyses inégalées qui ont influencé des transactions immobilières d'une valeur de plusieurs milliards de dollars et qui aident en permanence plus de 15 millions d'utilisateurs mensuels, sur 8 000 sites web aux États\-Unis et au Canada, à prendre des décisions plus éclairées.
   

  

 Au cours de l'été 2023, nous avons obtenu un financement de série B afin d'agrandir notre équipe, d'améliorer nos produits et, en fin de compte, d'aider à construire les villes de demain.
   

  

 Votre mission
   

  

 En tant que Scientifique de données senior chez Local Logic, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la façon dont les villes et l’immobilier sont compris, analysés et utilisés pour la prise de décision. Vous travaillerez à l’intersection des données urbaines, de l’analytique immobilière et des décisions produit, afin de faire émerger des insights qui influencent à la fois notre stratégie produit et les produits de données que nous mettons sur le marché.
   

  

 Vous prendrez en charge des problématiques complexes et ambiguës de bout en bout : de la formulation des bonnes questions, à la conception d’approches analytiques ou de modélisation robustes, jusqu’à la traduction des résultats en décisions concrètes et en produits. Vous travaillerez sur des jeux de données géospatiales et comportementales à grande échelle (continentale), en combinant rigueur quantitative et forte intuition produit.
   

  

 Ce rôle s’adresse à une ou un scientifique de données senior qui aime évoluer dans un environnement en constante évolution, qui valorise l’autonomie intellectuelle et qui souhaite que son travail ait un impact concret et visible sur la manière dont les gens comprennent les lieux et prennent des décisions immobilières.
   

  

 Vous croyez en notre mission et souhaitez contribuer activement à sa réalisation. Vous apportez votre point de vue unique à l’équipe et êtes à l’aise de remettre en question nos façons de faire afin de les améliorer. Vous savez vous exprimer lorsque vous êtes en désaccord, poser des questions lorsque quelque chose n’est pas clair et prendre pleinement la responsabilité de votre travail.
   

  

 Vos responsabilités incluront :
   

  

* Prendre en charge des problématiques analytiques et de modélisation à fort impact liées aux villes, à l’immobilier et à l’utilisation des produits, de l’exploration initiale jusqu’à la mise en production
* Mener des recherches quantitatives afin d’évaluer la valeur de nos données urbaines et immobilières pour nos principaux utilisateurs, notamment les acheteurs de propriétés, les villes, les plateformes immobilières et les investisseurs
* Concevoir, développer et évaluer des modèles statistiques et d’apprentissage automatique, en tenant compte des contraintes du monde réel, de la qualité des données et de l’interprétabilité
* Développer des preuves de concept pour de nouveaux produits de données et collaborer étroitement avec les ingénieur·e·s de données pour les mettre en production
* Définir et maintenir des pipelines d’analytique produit, des indicateurs clés et des rapports destinés aux équipes internes et aux partenaires externes
* Influencer la stratégie produit et la feuille de route grâce à des insights proactifs et à des recommandations fondées sur les données
* Agir comme référence méthodologique au sein de l’équipe de données, en contribuant à l’établissement de bonnes pratiques en matière d’analyse, de modélisation et de validation
* Être un·e gardien·ne de la qualité et de la fiabilité des données, en identifiant les risques et les compromis liés aux données et aux méthodes utilisées
* Communiquer de manière claire et convaincante, tant auprès de publics techniques que non techniques, au sujet des résultats, des hypothèses et des limites des analyses
* Rédiger des rapports analytiques pour les clients et partenaires, en français et en anglais


 Exigences clés
   

  

* 5 ans ou plus d’expérience en recherche quantitative et en science des données, avec une prise en charge démontrée de problématiques complexes
* Solide expérience de travail avec des données volumineuses, imparfaites et issues du monde réel
* Expérience avérée en apprentissage automatique et/ou en techniques avancées de modélisation, de la définition du problème à l’évaluation des résultats
* Bonne expérience en analytique produit, incluant la définition de métriques et le soutien à la prise de décision
* Excellentes compétences en programmation en Python et SQL pour l’analyse et la modélisation
* À l’aise dans des environnements ambigus et en évolution rapide, où la définition du problème fait partie intégrante du travail
* Excellentes aptitudes en communication, avec la capacité d’expliquer des analyses complexes à des auditoires variés
* Bilingue français et anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit
* Poste hybride, avec une présence attendue au bureau de Montréal les mardis et jeudis


 Atouts supplémentaires
   

  

* Expérience dans les domaines de l’immobilier, de l’analytique urbaine, de l’économétrie ou dans des domaines connexes (p. ex. analyse d’investissement, planification urbaine)
* Expérience pratique avec des données géospatiales et spatio\-temporelles (SIG, modélisation spatiale, indicateurs urbains, mobilité, accessibilité, etc.)
* Exposition à la modélisation du risque ou à la prise de décision en contexte d’incertitude


 Pourquoi travailler ici
   

  

 Chez Local Logic, vous avez l'opportunité de faire partie de l'équipe d'une jeune pousse, soutenue par sa série B. Nous nous concentrons sur la compréhension du monde et de ses villes pour prédire l'avenir et rendre le marché immobilier plus transparent.
   

  

 Nous sommes une entreprise qui priorise ses gens et qui s'efforce de créer la meilleure expérience pour ses employés en créant un environnement inclusif, collaboratif et stimulant pour apprendre et résoudre des problèmes au quotidien.
   

  

 Vous aurez accès à des avantages tels que:
   

  

* un régime d’assurance santé, de soins dentaires et de soins oculaires
* des options d'achat d'actions
* une politique de vacances compétitive
* une culture qui met l'accent sur l'apprentissage et l'harmonie entre vie professionnelle et vie privée
* Allocation initiale de travail à domicile

 Votre développement professionnel est notre priorité. Grâce à un crédit annuel de 1500 CAD développement professionnel, vous êtes encouragés à continuer d’apprendre, à explorer de nouvelles compétences et à progresser dans votre carrière. Nous voulons que vous vous épanouissiez, que vous progressiez et que vous vous sentiez épanoui tout en travaillant sur des tâches importantes. Rejoignez\-nous et aidez\-nous à construire un avenir meilleur pour les villes du monde entier.
   

  

 Notre engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l'inclusion
   

  

 Nous visons à constituer une équipe diversifiée et une culture d'entreprise inclusive. Nous sommes un employeur souscrivant au principe de l'égalité des chances et ne pratiquons aucune discrimination fondée sur la race, la couleur, l'appartenance ethnique, l'ascendance, l'origine nationale, la religion, le sexe, l'identité ou l'expression sexuelle, l'orientation sexuelle, l'âge, le handicap, le statut de vétéran, les informations génétiques, l'état matrimonial ou tout autre statut protégé par la loi.

**Product Manager (Customer Retention)**

The Product team is made up of strategic thinkers leading and guiding cross\-functional squads of Engineers, UX Designers and Data Scientists to ensure our customers and internal teams are delighted with every interaction. **What's involved…**



As a **Product Manager (Customer Retention)**, you will shape experiences that keep customers coming back—improving repeat purchase, loyalty engagement and long\-term customer value across THE ICONIC web and mobile app.



You will partner closely with senior leaders across the Customer Product team as well as cross\-functional groups including **Engineering, UX, Data, Customer Insights, Trade and Marketing/CRM** to align on where we invest time, effort, and budget to improve retention outcomes.



You will shape initiatives by clearly defining the **"Definition of Why"** (e.g. increasing customer retention, improving CSAT, lifting conversion, growing loyalty engagement, reducing returns, reducing operational cost, or scaling platform performance and stability). You'll collaborate daily with engineering teams to quantify opportunity sizes, evaluate technical options, define solution approaches, and build clear and realistic release plans.

* **Be the customer voice at the table**, representing customer needs and feedback to ensure user\-centric solutions.
* **Lead ideation and experimentation**, from hypothesis generation through monitoring and evaluation (e.g. A/B testing and iterative optimisation).
* **Use analytics and customer feedback** to pinpoint problems, size opportunities, and recommend what to build next.
* **Collaborate effectively across squads and stakeholders**, building trust, facilitating discussions, and ensuring the right approvals and oversight are in place.
* **Apply strong product fundamentals** such as Definition of Why, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done to drive clarity and delivery.
* **Deliver measurable outcomes** across key retention and experience metrics, such as:
	+ Customer Retention
	+ CSAT (Customer Satisfaction)
	+ Conversion Rate
	+ Traffic % on App
	+ Session duration
	+ Engagement with recommendations
	+ Average order value / average basket size
	+ Add to bag rate
	+ Return rate
	+ Loyalty programme engagement
	+ Timely delivery of roadmap milestones

* **Product Management experience**, including user\-facing products.
* Strong analytical capability—confident **analysing quantitative data** to identify opportunities and validate impact.
* Experience working in an **agile environment**.
* Demonstrated ability to create product roadmaps from conception to launch, facilitating ideation, leading design discussions, and driving delivery.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to **articulate complex problems simply** so others can contribute to solutions.
* Demonstrated stakeholder and relationship management experience.


**Ways to stand out from the crowd..**


* Proven experience driving outcomes in **retention, loyalty, engagement, or lifecycle** product areas in a high\-traffic, consumer\-facing environment.
* Experience with digital products (web and mobile) in **e\-commerce**.
* Experience partnering closely with **CRM/Marketing, Customer Insights, and Data Science** teams.
* Hands\-on experience with **experimentation frameworks** and interpreting test results to inform product decisions.

description:
Work with cutting edge AI technology, making the world a safer and more secure place. DroneShield (ASX:DRO) offers an opportunity to solve some of world’s most challenging technical problems in the rapidly growing counter\-drone sector.


Our customers operate in some of the most challenging and high\-stakes environments in the world, including military organisations, government agencies, airports, critical infrastructure operators, and law enforcement. Protecting airspace in these settings requires technology that performs under pressure and teams that understand what’s at stake. At DroneShield, employees work at the leading edge of counter\-drone innovation, helping to address real\-world security challenges as drone threats continue to evolve globally.


With one of the largest listed defence company market capitalisations in Australia, now part of the ASX200 index, DroneShield is experiencing a period of hypergrowth. Revenue has surged from A$57 million in 2024 to over A$190 million in 2025, representing growth of more than 400% year\-on\-year, with record profitability and cashflow. The total addressable global market for counter\-drone is assessed at approximately $100 billion, and is currently at the nascent stage with much of the growth still to come, with DroneShield well positioned as a global market leader, and the only public listed pure\-play business in this sector.


The company has grown from 11 employees in 2017 to over 450 staff globally today, and is on track to reach around 550 by the end of 2026\. This expansion includes investment of over A$50 million annually in R\&D, a global pipeline exceeding A$2\.5 billion, and continuous scaling of production capacity to meet accelerating demand.


The role is based at DroneShield’s central Sydney headquarters. Overseas on\-the\-ground presence includes Virginia (USA), Netherlands, Denmark, Mexico and Dubai, as well as distributors in over 70 countries worldwide.

 **About the role**


DroneShield is seeking a hands\-on QA Software Engineer with experience in software system validation and exposure to AI/ML\-driven and sensor\-integrated platforms. You will contribute to test execution, automation, and quality practices across Linux\-based systems that integrate software services, firmware components, intelligent models, and sensors.


In this role, you will work closely with engineers across software, data, and DevOps teams to support end\-to\-end QA activities, including functional, integration, and regression testing.


The ideal candidate is a motivated team player who can plan and execute testing tasks independently, contribute to automation efforts, and continuously improve product quality within a collaborative, fast\-paced environment.

**Responsibilities, Duties and Expectations**

* Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests across software components and integrated systems.
* Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines under guidance from senior engineers.
* Plan and execute test cycles for software features, APIs, and integrated solutions.
* Perform hands\-on testing, including functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Support field testing activities for embedded or integrated products when required.
* Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, and DevOps teams to improve test coverage and product quality.
* Create and maintain test cases, test data, and test documentation in test management tools.
* Identify, log, and track defects, and assist in root\-cause analysis.
* Actively participate in improving QA processes, standards, and test practices.

**Qualifications, Experience and Skills**

* 3–6 years of experience as a QA or Software Test Engineer.
* Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals across web, API, and backend systems.
* Working knowledge of Linux and test automation tools such as Selenium, Pytest, Playwright, or K6\.
* Programming or scripting experience in Python, JavaScript, or Go.
* Hands\-on experience with test management tools such as Xray, Zephyr, or QMetry.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and basic containerisation concepts (e.g. Docker).
* Ability to plan and execute testing tasks independently with guidance when needed.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and communication skills.

**Desirable**

* Exposure to embedded systems, IoT, or hardware\-integrated software testing.
* Experience with non\-functional testing, including performance or reliability testing.
* Familiarity with testing AI/ML\-driven or data\-intensive systems.
* Awareness of sensor\-based systems or edge\-device testing concepts.

title: Data Scientist (Masters)
description:
**Data Scientist (Masters) \- AI Data Trainer**
* Location: Remote


**About The Job**
 At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting\-edge AI models.
   

  

 You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like machine learning theory, statistical inference, neural network architectures, and data engineering pipelines—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.
   

  

**Organization** 
 : Alignerr
 **Position** 
 : Data Scientist (Masters) \- AI Data Trainer
 **Type** 
 : Hourly Contract
 **Compensation** 
 : $40–$80 /hour
 **Location** 
 : Remote
 **Commitment** 
 : 10–40 hours/week
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develop Complex Problems: Design advanced data science challenges across domains like hyperparameter optimization, Bayesian inference, cross\-validation strategies, and dimensionality reduction.
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions: Create rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions including Python/R scripts, SQL queries, and mathematical derivations that serve as "golden responses."
* Technical Auditing: Evaluate AI\-generated code (using libraries like Scikit\-Learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow), data visualizations, and statistical summaries for technical accuracy and efficiency.
* Refine Reasoning: Identify logical fallacies in AI reasoning—such as data leakage, overfitting, or improper handling of imbalanced datasets—and provide structured feedback to improve the model's "thinking" process.


**Requirements**
* Advanced Degree: Masters (pursuing or completed) or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field with a heavy emphasis on data analysis.
* Domain Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge in core areas such as supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, big data technologies (Spark/Hadoop), or NLP.
* Analytical Writing: The ability to communicate highly technical algorithmic concepts and statistical results clearly and concisely in written form.
* Attention to Detail: High level of precision when checking code syntax, mathematical notation, and the validity of statistical conclusions.
* No AI experience required


**Preferred**
* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
* Proficiency in production\-level data science workflows (e.g., MLOps, CI/CD for models).


**Why Join Us**
* Excellent compensation with location\-independent flexibility.
* Direct engagement with industry\-leading LLMs.
* Contractor advantages: high agency, agility, and international reach.
* More opportunities for contracting renewals.


**Application Process (Takes 15\-20 min)**
* Submit your resume
* Complete a short screening
* Project matching and onboarding


*PS: Our team reviews applications daily. Please complete your AI interview and application steps to be considered for this opportunity.*

title: Performance Insights and Reporting Manager
description:
**Performance Insights and Reporting Manager**


At Bupa, purpose meets possible. Join us and help shape a future where healthcare is more connected, more personal and more human.


We’re a global healthcare leader trusted by millions and committed to helping people to live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. Healthcare is changing, and so are we. We’re investing in more clinics, better systems and smarter, more connected ways to help our customers. As we continue to expand our services and invest in innovation, you’ll help create a healthcare system that meets people where they are, responds to what they need and leaves them better than before.


Here, your work has purpose, your voice matters and your future is full of possibility.


Just imagine the impact you could make.

**The purpose of this job**:


Bupa is Australia’s largest health insurer and is committed to helping people live longer, healthier and happier lives. It supports the health and wellbeing needs of more than 4 million health insurance customers.


Bupa has embarked on a program to evolve its health insurance business, delivering personalised, radically simple and relevant experience for customers. Our strategy involves optimising the business of today, while reimagining the future of health and wellbeing and growing the business of tomorrow.


The Health Programs team is part of Bupa’s Healthcare Programs and Claims Innovation team and is responsible for the delivery and expansion of alternative models of healthcare delivery that supports value based healthcare. The goal is to improve the health outcomes and experience of Bupa members, while also supporting customer choice and access to affordable, timely healthcare in the right setting.


As the Performance Insights and Reporting Manager, you will report to the Senior Manager, Health Programs Operations. You will be responsible for leading the performance and reporting function for Health Programs, as well as supporting workforce management for the Bupa Telehealth team.

**What you’ll need to make it possible**

* Tertiary qualifications in a relevant data or business\-related field
* At least five years’ experience in a data analytics, reporting or workforce role.
* Experience across either private health insurance, private healthcare and/or public healthcare is highly regarded.
* Excellent team and talent development skills, with evidence of having established high performing teams.
* Passion for innovation and going outside the box to figure out new ways of delivering continuous improvements.
* Extensive demonstrated people leadership experience.
* Experience with data analysis, data warehousing and reporting in a health\-related field is highly regarded.
**What you’ll be doing in this role:**


The Performance Insights and Reporting Manager delivers on the position purpose through the following responsibilities:

* Lead and own the performance and reporting function for Health Programs.
* Manage and monitor the performance of Healthcare Programs and Bupa Telehealth, provide operational insights, and make data\-driven recommendations that inform strategic and operational decisions across Health Programs.
* Collaborate with Technology, and other teams, to migrate and integrate data assets to a new strategic data platform, ensuring data engineering best practices are followed to enable scalable and future ready reporting capabilities.
* Work closely with Data Scientists, leverage AI and other methodologies to produce regular performance insights and demand forecasting aligned to KPIs.
* Manage the effective distribution of incoming work in Bupa Telehealth, set a prioritisation framework and oversee workload balance across the team.
* Partner with the Healthcare Program team, the Bupa Telehealth Leadership team and Data Scientists to optimise customer targeting and engagement.

Why you’ll **love it**?


We support our people to be the healthiest and happiest versions of themselves.


If this sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s shape the future of healthcare, together.

*At Bupa your wellbeing, identity, and personal story are respected and valued. We are continuing to build teams that reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. Bupa is committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering a workplace and environment that is free of discrimination, bullying and harassment.*

*We actively encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, veterans, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA\+ applicants.*

*We are dedicated to removing barriers to participation. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, or if you’d like to discuss how this role can be flexible for you, please let us know so we can support your participation on an equitable basis.*

description:
**Join us on our mission to make a better world of work.**



Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,500 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high\-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.



Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.



For more information visit cultureamp.com.


***How you can help make a better world of work***



We’re looking for a Senior UX Researcher to drive actionable insights at the intersection of human psychology and AI product experiences. You will lead research for our AI\-powered coaching and performance tools, shaping intuitive, trustworthy, and high\-impact workflows that empower employees globally.



In this role, you’ll move beyond usability to explore the ‘black box’ of AI – investigating how trust is built, how transparency is maintained, and how AI can feel like a collaborative partner rather than just another tool. You’ll join a team of passionate humans dedicated to turning mixed\-methods research into product direction at speed.


### **As part of our team, you will:**


* **Scope and lead strategic research:** Define and manage research programs that clarify where and how AI should assist users, ensuring alignment with both user needs and business goals.
* **Define AI excellence:** Establish evaluation frameworks for AI experiences (focusing on trust, controllability, and safety) and translate these into design principles and reusable patterns the team can ship with confidence.
* **Have a flexible research approach:** Creatively adapt your broad research toolkit – from generative interviews to quantitative experiments – to navigate ambiguous or multi\-faceted AI challenges.
* **Bridge disciplines and drive alignment:** Partner with Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, and People Scientists to shape hypotheses and use data to drive clarity on high\-stakes product bets
* **Narrate with influence:** Socialise findings through compelling storytelling and visualisation, tailoring your communication to move audiences from interesting data to strategic action

### **You have:**


* **5\+ years of UX Research experience:** You’ve run complex, end\-to\-end studies in a fast\-paced SaaS environment; experience with AI\-assisted workflows or LLMs is highly regarded.
* **Complexity management:** A proven ability to contextualise problems within larger technical systems and anticipate the downstream effects of product decisions.
* **Strategic influence:** A track record of building strong cross\-functional relationships and using data to influence senior\-level decision\-makers.
* **Mixed\-methods toolkit:** Deep proficiency in qualitative and quantitative methods, with the ability to synthesise disparate data points into a single, actionable narrative.
* **Systems thinking \& scalability:** You look beyond individual workflows to ensure AI patterns remain consistent, extensible, and cohesive as they scale across the entire Culture Amp platform.

As a Senior Data Engineer in the Data \& AI team, you will be instrumental in building and evolving our modern analytics and AI platform. This role focuses on enabling machine learning and generative AI solutions at scale by delivering robust, secure, and high\-performing data environments.


You will work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and the Gen AI team, as well as collaborate with integration and governance teams, to design and implement production\-ready pipelines, feature stores, and model deployment frameworks.  As a Data Scientist, you can expect every day to be different, but there are a few workflows that are consistent. You will do this in accordance with our legislative, policy and ethical frameworks.
 



  





 In your role, you will be expected to liaise with both customers and engineers and will need to be able to explain the methods and results of your work to people with varying levels of data science experience. Continuous learning and a thirst for knowledge are expected as you maintain your knowledge of both our abilities and the state of the art possibilities, blending the best of what the data science community has on offer. You will need to work in a multi\-disciplinary environment to deliver capabilities that allow ASD’s intelligence and cyber analysts to have the right information, provided in the right way at the right time.
 



  





 Further information can be found at: I’m changing my career \| Australian Signals Directorate (asd.gov.au).
 



  





**Key Duties:** 




**ASD 4 Data Scientist** 




 An ASD 4 Data Scientists, you will work to the broad direction of the executive leadership to perform and achieve complex data generation and analysis work within an integrated workforce. You will require knowledge of compliance with the legislative frameworks, government decision\-making and an understanding of Australian Signals Directorate’s mission.
 



  





 You will be deliberate with the learning of technical and analytical skills and proactive with communicating with their team and leadership. You will exercise sound decision\-making to provide technical advice and in line with direction, will engage in complex problem solving to deliver data science solutions that affect strategic, political or operational outcomes for the Australian Signals Directorate.
 



  





 You will positively contribute to building team capability and will be accountable to contribute towards ongoing self\-improvement and professional development for their career.
 



  





**ASD 5 Data Scientist** 




 An ASD 5 Data Scientist will work under limited direction to perform and achieve complex data generation and analysis work within an integrated workforce. You are accountable to have and maintain a well\-developed understanding of compliance to relevant legislative frameworks, government decision\-making and the Australian Signals Directorate’s mission and policy requirements.
 



  





 You will be accountable for organising your workflow and making independent decisions relating to their area of responsibility. You will interpret and provide advice within the data function area based on legislation, policy and procedures. You will undertake research and analysis, conduct investigations and perform data generation and analysis work to achieve results.
 



  





 You may coordinate and contribute to the work of a team and provide advice and assistance on methods of task completion to team members. You may be a team coach and are expected to be capable of reviewing and developing the quality of work undertaken by others and identifying opportunities for on\-the\-job training within a work unit.
 



  





 As a Data Scientist, you will be required to engage and communicate with stakeholders to respond and provide advice on issues to mission outcomes. You will be accountable to contribute towards ongoing self\-improvement and professional development.
 



  





**ASD 6 Data Scientist** 




 An ASD 6 Data Scientist is accountable, under the broad direction of the executive leadership, to perform and achieve complex to very complex data generation and analysis work within an integrated workforce. You will require knowledge of compliance with legislative frameworks, government decision\-making and strong understanding of Australian Signals Directorate’s mission.
 



  





 You will exercise a degree of independence and perform a subject matter expert role. You will exercise sound decision making and judgement to provide strong technical advice. Engage in complex to very complex problem solving and issue management and may coordinate and contribute to detailed or sensitive projects that impact on strategic, political or operational outcomes for the Australian Signals Directorate.
 



  





 You may be a Line Manager and mentor, and will be accountable for the outcomes of the planning for work and performance goals. You are expected to be capable of building team capability through coaching, feedback and developing the quality of work undertaken by others within a work unit.
 



  





 As a Data Scientist, you will be involved in key stakeholder relationships and will be required to identify relevant stakeholders’ expectations and concerns to develop and communicate methodologies and practices to achieve outcomes. You will be accountable to contribute towards ongoing self\-improvement and professional development of their work area.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 Data scientist roles within Mission Data Division (MDD) develops capabilities and data solutions to enable ASD mission areas, to support ASD and ADF mission requirements.
 



  





 This is achieved through the delivery of data platforms, ensuring the data is fit for purpose, delivering bespoke mission tools and applications, and providing complex analytic support, including Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence capability.
 



  





 As part of your job, ASD will support you and provide opportunities to stay up\-to\-date with the latest trends and technologies to develop new ways to collect information and solve intelligence problems. The work we do is unique, critical and incredibly rewarding.

 Our ideal candidate has a thirst for learning and an ability to convince data to tell its story. They can have industry experience, formal training or a particular domain expertise but regardless of this, they must have strong critical thinking and reasoning and be able to demonstrate this through the selection process. At the core of their skills is an understanding of the fundamentals of data or geospatial analysis and/or data science. Our ideal candidate embraces diversity and is willing to approach problems from a cross disciplinary perspective. They have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to ask the right questions. Most importantly, they need to enjoy working as part of a dynamic team to solve interesting problems.

Join us at Sparksoft, where we're not just another tech company—we're a catalyst for change. Our mission isn't just to offer IT solutions; it's to revolutionize the way you work. Here, passion isn't just a buzzword; it's the fuel behind groundbreaking ideas and transformative technologies. We serve a wide range of government clients, delivering impact that's felt across the nation.
   

  

 Our true strength lies in our people. They're the problem\-solvers and innovators consistently delivering extraordinary outcomes. With Sparksoft, you're not stepping into a routine job; you're joining a team committed to innovation and excellence. Our innovation extends beyond just delivering projects. Through our specialized Innovation Centers, we continuously refine our methods, ensuring we remain industry leaders.
   

  

 We are Sparksoft!
   

  

**ROLE \& RESPONSIBILITIES:**
 The Data Scientist will ensure continuous improvement of the program’s data quality through solutions and strategies to address business challenges. This role involves working closely with data operations and reporting teams to design, develop, and execute automated data reporting solutions with the highest standards of quality and performance. This role requires a strong technical background, excellent problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a SAFe Agile environment. The Data Scientist will play a critical role in improving the quality and accessibility of data solutions to support the Centers for Medicare \& Medicaid Services (CMS) in detecting and preventing fraud, waste, and abuse within government\-sponsored health programs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Collaborate with product owners, customers, team members, and leaders to shape data\-driven strategies.
* Develop solutions and strategies to address business challenges.
* Research and devise innovative statistical models for data analysis.
* Automate repetitive reports and deliveries
* Apply statistical methods, machine learning, and artificial intelligence tools to detect anomalies and trends to make informed decisions.
* Run data pilot analysis, comparative performance analysis.
* Streamline performance and data quality analysis on various data sources.
* Develop and deploy machine learning models into production environment by collaborating with other engineers and developers.
* Monitoring model performance, refine/update models algorithms as needed.
* Collaborate with internal teams and developers to design, develop, automate and maintain data analytics reports and dashboards.
* Provide support in ad\-hoc analysis to meet customer needs.
* Present insights and findings to business owners, customers, and leadership.
* Able to effectively transfer knowledge and train team members in the processes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives, to provide input on testing progress and challenges.
* Continuously improve testing processes, tools, and techniques to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the testing efforts.


**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Data Scientist or similar role.
* Experience with data analytics tools (SQL, R, Python) and data visualization tools (like Tableau, PowerBI, AWS Quicksight).
* Experience designing, training, validating, and deploying machine learning models and algorithms.
* Experience with cloud computing tools such as AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Experience with the version control systems (GitHub)
* Knowledge of databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and data modeling.
* Experience with agile methodologies (SAFe, Scrum) and tools (Jira, Confluence).
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, agile environment and deadline\-driven environment.
* Proven track record of innovation and continuous improvement.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
* Must have lived in the United States 3 out of the past 5 years.


**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**
* SAFe Agile Certification
* Assess/evaluate to deliver timely data analysis, and data solutions against client requirements.
* Ensure customer satisfaction through follow\-up, client responsiveness, and thorough communication.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and projects/tasks simultaneously.
* Experience in healthcare IT and understanding of regulatory requirements such as HIPAA.
* Experience and/or knowledge of CMS processes and standards.


**EDUCATION \& CERTIFICATIONS:**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Math, Data Science, or related field.


**WHAT WE OFFER:**
 At Sparksoft, we know that people do their best work when they feel supported, inspired, and connected. That’s why we’ve built a workplace that balances comprehensive benefits with a culture of collaboration and innovation. From flexible time off to professional growth opportunities, we’re committed to helping you thrive both inside and outside of work. When you join Sparksoft, you’ll enjoy:
   

  

* Competitive compensation and a 401(k) with employer contributions to help you plan for the future
* Flexible paid time off and hybrid ways of working that support true work\-life balance
* Comprehensive health coverage—including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
* A curated in\-office experience designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
* Opportunities to give back through Sparksoft Cares, including annual company\-wide fundraising events
* Training and development programs that build new skills and prepare you for leadership roles
* A collaborative, transparent, and fun culture—recognized as a Great Place to Work®


**Accessibility and Accommodations:** 
 Sparksoft Corporation is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at Sparksoft.Accommodations@sparksoftcorp.com or call 410\-424\-7700\. Requests are reviewed and fulfilled on a case\-by\-case basis.
   

  

**Security Notice:** 
 Your privacy and data security are important to us. Sparksoft Corporation will never request sensitive personal information via email. If you receive any suspicious communication claiming to be from Sparksoft, please report it immediately to our security team at abuse@sparksoftcorp.com.
   

  

**Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy:** 
 While Sparksoft recognizes the value of artificial intelligence in the workplace, our hiring process is designed to assess each candidate’s individual skills, judgment, and problem\-solving abilities. To maintain the integrity of this process, the use of AI tools at any stage of the application or interview is strictly prohibited. Violations of this policy may result in disqualification from consideration.

title: Data Scientist, Product Analytics
description:
As a Data Scientist at Meta, you will shape the future of people\-facing and business\-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Oculus). By applying your technical skills, analytical mindset, and product intuition to one of the richest data sets in the world, you will help define the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses around the world. You will collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a wide\-range of cross\-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Research, Data Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance and others. You will use data and analysis to identify and solve product development's biggest challenges. You will influence product strategy and investment decisions with data, be focused on impact, and collaborate with other teams. By joining Meta, you will become part of a world\-class analytics community dedicated to skill development and career growth in analytics and beyond.Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and ensure the products we build bring value to people, businesses, and Meta. You will help your partner teams prioritize what to build, set goals, and understand their product's ecosystem.Analytics: You will guide teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and employ a varied toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data\-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.

* Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches

* Identify and measure success of product efforts through goal setting, forecasting, and monitoring of key product metrics to understand trends
* Define, understand, and test opportunities and levers to improve the product, and drive roadmaps through your insights and recommendations
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and cross\-functional teams to inform, influence, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* A minimum of 6 years of work experience in analytics (minimum of 4 years with a Ph.D.)

* Experience with data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python), and/or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R)


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's or Ph.D. Degree in a quantitative field

title: Research Data Scientist
description:
The
 *University of Notre Dame* 
 is more than a workplace; it is a vibrant, mission\-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit.
